summary: Single motorcycle rider ejected in the Poudre Canyon and landed near the river about 40 vertical feet from the roadway; LCSAR executed a technical raise from the river's edge to the roadway so the patient could be transferred to UCHealth EMS and UCHealth LifeLine.
location: Poudre Canyon, ~40 vertical feet below the roadway near the river
notes: Date approximate: post timestamped 2020-04-08 02:25 UTC (2020-04-07 20:25 MDT) says 'this afternoon'.
